correctness.rationale: Reconstructed the two shells (12 cyclic (0,±1,±phi) and 20 cyclic (0,±phi,±phi^{-1}) or independent ±1 triples), six-generator zonotope Z=2phi P, 15 cross-product facet-normal pairs, and zonotope volume sum 8*sum|det(g_i,g_j,g_k)|=20(2phi)^3. Independent exact Z[phi] four-combination enumeration computed C(32,4)=35960, exactly 39 levels, 2340 dependent quadruples, maximum determinant 6+8phi with multiplicity 20. The 20 maximizing 4-sets intersect pairwise in at most 2 vertices. Multi-affinity of oriented determinant in each of four vertex positions and equality in convex combinations implies every global optimizer is supported on four vertices: a nonvertex would force two extreme 4-sets sharing three vertices, impossible. The code is an exhaustive finite certificate for this fixed 32-vertex point set, not an infinite-family theorem; ring sign comparisons use 2(a+b phi)=(2a+b)+b sqrt(5). Source exact 39-level table and all 30 rhombic facets inspected, but independent histogram check here corroborated its counts, max, and isolation rather than independently recreating the entire 39-entry table.
